text_blocks.snippet: A barium swallow is a medical imaging test that uses a contrast agent called barium to visualize the upper gastrointestinal (GI) tract, including the esophagus, stomach, and part of the small intestine. Fluoroscopy is a real-time imaging technique that allows the doctor to observe the movement of the barium through the GI tract as the patient swallows.
Therefore, a fluoroscopy is a type of barium swallow that provides dynamic imaging of the upper GI tract.
